d:
Anant Singh ke bare damad kumar punit in dinon charcha men hain. anant sinh ki beti shivangi ki shadi ke bich unke bare damad ki bhi khub charcha ho rahi hai. kumar punit UPSC pas kar sarkari seva men pahunche hain aur philhal lebar dipartament men karyarat hain. rajnitik parivar se rishta hone ke bavjud unhonne rajniti ke bajay prashasnik seva ko chuna hai. aakhir kaun hain kumar punit aur rajniti men aane ko lekar unka kya kahna hai? dekhie ye khas prophail.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
